description: RTK build/linter command detection currently uses unanchored substring matching. An SSH command referencing github.com/nats-io/natscli is misclassified as `tsc`, and its output is replaced with a synthetic build-success summary. Restrict routing to recognized top-level commands (after supported command prefixes/wrappers), preserve SSH/Python output, and add exact regression coverage. Validate lint, tests, and typecheck.

comments.text: Implemented top-level RTK command matching via shared command-prefix helper. Build, linter, and Docker classifiers no longer scan arbitrary SSH/Python arguments; exact natscli/tsc regression preserves raw output. Plain sudo/env/command wrappers, leading assignments, npx tsc, and shell whitespace remain supported. Added direct routing and false-positive regressions. Root validation passed: lint (687 files), tests (442 files / 2,359 tests), and all workspace typechecks.

Addressed Codex PR finding: sudo wrapper normalization now consumes legitimate options, including options with separate or attached values, before classifying the wrapped executable. Added regressions for `sudo -E`, `sudo --preserve-env`, `sudo -u root`, combined `-Eu root`, and nested SSH safety. Root lint, 442 test files / 2,359 tests, and all workspace typechecks pass.

Assessed all three follow-up Codex findings as valid and in-scope: sudo non-execution modes could cause destructive false-positive compression; env option parsing and empty assignments were parity regressions in wrappers this change explicitly supports. Replaced ad hoc sudo-only handling with a shared fail-open wrapper option parser for command/sudo/env, explicitly rejecting non-execution modes and unknown options. Preserved assignment grammar context so `command CI= npm run build` is not misclassified, while leading/sudo/env assignments remain supported. Added regressions for all reported cases plus `sudo -U/--other-user`. Root lint, 442 test files / 2,361 tests, and all workspace typechecks pass.

title: Prevent RTK classifiers from consuming wrapped SSH and Python output
